Predicates:
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
OccurIn(x, y) ::: x can occur in y.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Symptom(x, y) ::: y is a symptom of x.
FeelTired(x) ::: x feels tired.
Glu(x) ::: x gets a glu.

Premises:
Monkeypox is an infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus.
MonkeypoxVirus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
Humans are mammals.
Mammals are animals.
Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
People feel tired when they get a glu.

Conclusion:
∃x (Animal(x)) ::: There is an animal.
